verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only role-based controls: the organization plugin lets you assign roles and permissions, the admin plugin manages user roles, and a community comment mentions RBAC. Nothing shows resource-level, relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy-based (ABAC) authorization beyond roles. Role and permission management is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can express fine-grained, resource-level authorization (relationship- or policy-based) beyond simple roles
